WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_repl,
         AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_fee_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fee_per_day) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_rating
  WHERE avg_fee_per_day IS NOT NULL
),
paired AS (
  SELECT p.rating,
         p.avg_repl,
         p.avg_fee_per_day,
         o.overall_avg,
         p.avg_fee_per_day - o.overall_avg AS diff
  FROM per_rating p
  JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  WHERE p.avg_fee_per_day IS NOT NULL
    AND p.avg_fee_per_day > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_repl) AS avg_replacement_cost,
       AVG(avg_fee_per_day) AS avg_fee_to_duration,
       AVG(diff) AS avg_difference_from_overall
FROM paired
